correctness.rationale: The parent-colour Pólya urn yields S_n uniform over 1..n-1; conditional on any colour history, each colour induces an independent recursive tree and only the single blue-root boundary requires subtraction. Eulerian insertion identifies X_m with cyclic descents on m i.i.d. continuous ranks. Every connected joint-cumulant pattern of r<m cycle edges is a proper path, occurring m times; thus kappa_r(X_m)=m c_r, so the independent split matches all cumulants and moments of X_n through r<min(s,n-s). A chain is the sole one-leaf whole tree, probability 1/(n-1)!, while interior sums cannot have one leaf; nonidentity is rigorous. The two boundary corrections give covariance -(n-2)/(2(n-1)); independent exact enumeration n=3..7 checked uniformity and covariance. This is a finite-distribution theorem, not independence or a conclusion beyond the strict moment bound.
